Translate a batch of Chinese UI strings from a DeepSeek Harness plugin ("Dsh Whale Balance Widget" — a whale-girl character widget showing API balance) into fluent English. INPUT FILE (read ONLY your assigned line range): C:\Users\hoang\OneDrive\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\whale-list.tsv Read lines 1–240 inclusive (use the read tool with offset=1, limit=240). Format of each line is TAB-separated: \t\t\t OUTPUT FILE (create exactly this): C:\Users\hoang\OneDrive\Documents\deepseek-harness\default-workspace\xlate-1.json Write a JSON object mapping each ORIGINAL Chinese string (exact, as it appears inside the JSON quotes on the line, unescaped to the real characters) to its English translation: { "取消": "Cancel", "默认": "Default", ... } CRITICAL RULES — these strings are substituted back into a live JavaScript bundle, so: 1. **Preserve every placeholder token EXACTLY and in place**: `{cost}`, `{balance}`, `{today}`, `{quota}`, `{quota_used}`, `{quota_left}`, `{quota_total}`, `{quota_reset}`, `{expense_ds}`, `{balance_ds}`, `{bonus_ds}`, `{recharge_ds}`, `{session}`, `{status}`, `{countdown}`, `{plan}`, `{plan_left}`, `{plan_reset}`, `{amount}`, `{below}`, `{modelName}`, `{model}` etc. Never translate or reorder them. Example: `"例: 今日已用 {expense_ds}"` → `"e.g. today's spend {expense_ds}"` 2. **Some strings are HTML fragments and MUST stay valid HTML.** Keep every tag, attribute, `style=` value, `class=`, and entity (`&`, `<`) byte-identical — translate only the visible human text between tags. Example: `"
加载失败
"` → `"
Load failed
"` 3. **Many entries are FRAGMENTS concatenated with other text or numbers at runtime.** Translate them so they read naturally in English when joined, and keep leading/trailing spaces and punctuation exactly. Examples: - `" · 今日 "` → `" · Today "` (keeps surrounding spaces and the middle dot) - `" 个模块"` → `" modules"` - `" › 返回"` → `"‹ Back"` — wait, keep punctuation as-is: `"‹ 返回"` → `"‹ Back"` - `" 元"` → `" CNY"` (currency unit) - `"；模板变量 {balance} / {today}"` → `"; template variables {balance} / {today}"` 4. **Whale-girl personality lines** (the character's random speech bubbles, e.g. 恭喜你实现token自由！, 你这个吃白饭的用户！, 疯狂星期四你能V50亿token吗, 没吃饱喵, 看不太懂，瞎编一个应付下用户先) must keep their playful, sassy, meme-y tone. Do NOT sanitize them into corporate English — match the original's humour. `喵` is a cat-noise particle: render as a playful "meow" or drop it if it reads badly, your call. 5. **Keep product/company names as-is** where they are proper nouns: DeepSeek, Codex, GPT image 2, New API, Ollama, Claude, Kimi, GLM, StepFun, Ark, OpenCode Go, Minecraft. Vendor names that are Chinese (硅基流动 → SiliconFlow, 火山方舟 → Volcano Ark, 智谱 → Zhipu, 腾讯混元 → Tencent Hunyuan, 讯飞星火 → iFlytek Spark, 百度千帆 → Baidu Qianfan, 阿里云百炼 → Alibaba Cloud Model Studio, 阶跃星辰 → StepFun) use the official English name. 6. **Do not translate** strings that are pure numbers/symbols/emoji; copy them through unchanged. 7. Every key you emit MUST be copied exactly from the input (same characters, same spaces). A single mismatched character means the substitution silently fails. WORKFLOW: - Read your assigned lines. - Produce the JSON for exactly those entries (do not add or omit any). - Write the output file. - Report: number of entries written, and any entry you were unsure about. Your parent agent id is "session-5f849a2d-cf55-4d27-9f63-051eb23432de". Before you finish, send your result to that agent with send_message({ agent_id: "session-5f849a2d-cf55-4d27-9f63-051eb23432de", message: "" }). The parent shares your workspace but does not automatically receive your transcript, tool output, or reasoning. Send earlier messages as well when a finding changes what the parent should do next; sending a message does not end your turn.
